relationships.description: The dashboard surfaces the firing state and history of the alert rule in a panel, giving operators a visual status view of that rule alongside related telemetry.
relationships.evidence: The dashboard JSON or Terraform resource contains an alert-list or alert-status panel that references the alert rule by its UID, name or monitor ID.

relationships.description: The dashboard contains a log panel whose query selects occurrences of this kind of log record, letting operators inspect or count those events over time.
relationships.evidence: A panel in the dashboard definition carries a log query (e.g. LogQL, Datadog log search) that filters on the log record's message template, event name or distinguishing attributes.

relationships.description: The dashboard visualizes time series recorded by the metric instrument, plotting its measurements in one or more panels for human inspection.
relationships.evidence: A panel query in the dashboard JSON or resource (e.g. PromQL, Datadog metric query) references the metric name emitted by the instrument declared in code via the Meter API.

relationships.description: The dashboard presents the health of the API operation, such as its request rate, error rate and latency, so operators can watch that specific method-path endpoint.
relationships.evidence: Panel queries in the dashboard filter telemetry on the operation's HTTP method and route template (e.g. http.route="/orders/{id}" and http.request.method="GET").

relationships.description: The dashboard displays trace-derived data for the span, such as its duration distribution, throughput or error status, giving a visual view of that instrumented unit of work.
relationships.evidence: A panel query in the dashboard definition selects spans or span-derived metrics by the span name and kind declared at the tracer.startSpan call site or by the instrumentation library.

notes: The api.operation relationship is indirect: dashboards observe telemetry (spans, metrics) about the operation rather than the contract itself, overlapping with monitors span/metricinstrument. Monitors alert is closer to 'references' or 'associated-with', since the dashboard displays alert state rather than observing a running system.
